dict.string: ShenzhenQR reads QR codes and barcodes from the camera you choose. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
ShenzhenQR reads the name of the Wi-Fi network you’re on, to make a code others can scan to join it. macOS counts Wi-Fi names as location. Your location itself isn’t used.
